descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S22 Real camera capture on iPhone and Android

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A less-than-perfect photo (an imperfect or angled photo, not only a clean screenshot) still produces a usable result. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2; TFA-92580 How it works 2-3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack only. Android: the debug APK bundled for the local stack (scripts/android-lane.ts, adb reverse tcp:4510 and tcp:4511). iOS: an Xcode debug build pointed at the host's local stack on 4510/4511. Never the store or TestFlight builds, which point at dev . An @roundai.test account

When Photograph a printed synthetic census at an angle under ward-like light with the camera, then pick a screenshot from the photo library, in both contexts

Then The camera opens from the capture control. The iPhone photo (HEIC) is read. Both give the same rows as the web scan

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A tester compares the rows on the device's scan sheet with the printed truth. If a physical iPhone cannot reach the local stack, the iOS half is recorded as blocked (needs-dev-or-prod) and is not run against dev

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (debug build on local, or store build on dev); Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S22

Real camera capture on iPhone and Android

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

Device-only: needs a physical iPhone / Android build pointed at the local stack, a printed census and a camera; not run (brief 4: record as Manual). Related candidate from the 2026-10-15 Android emulator run: N9 ('Take Photo or Choose Image' opens the photo picker, never the camera, even with camera permission granted) and N10 (camera permission denied: the button does nothing). Even on a device, every read would currently come back empty on dev (B01).

Evidence: 0 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Real camera capture on an iPhone and an Android phone.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
